data.name: Imrana
data.gender_notes: Imrana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Ameeran, meaning 'faithful'. The name Imrana carries the meaning “Faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imrana usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is faithful to Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Imrana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imrana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إمرانة
in_arabic.meaning: إمرانة تعني القوة و النمو و التطور
in_arabic.long_meaning: إمرانة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أمَرَ' الذي يعني النمو و التطور. ورد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَأَمْرُنا لِلْمَرْءِ مَاضٍ' (الأحزاب: 5). يرمز الاسم للقوة و الصبر و النمو الروحي و العاطفي

in_urdu.name: امرانہ
in_urdu.meaning: امرانہ کا مطلب ہے طاقت، نمو اور ترقی
in_urdu.long_meaning: امرانہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی جڑ 'أمَرَ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نمو اور ترقی۔ یہ جڑ قرآن کریم میں کئی مقامات پر ذکر کی گئی ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: 'وَأَمْرُنا لِلْمَرْءِ مَاضٍ' (الأحزاب: 5). یہ نام طاقت، صبر اور روحانی و عاطفی نمو کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: इमराना
in_hindi.meaning: इमराना का अर्थ है शक्ति, विकास और उन्नति
in_hindi.long_meaning: इमराना एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल 'أمَرَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विकास और उन्नति। यह मूल कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि 'وَأَمْرُنا لِلْمَرْءِ مَاضٍ' (الأحزاب: 5)। यह नाम शक्ति, धैर्य और आत्मिक और भावनात्मक विकास का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: امرنہ
in_pashto.meaning: امرنہ معنی یې ځواک، وده او پرمختګ
in_pashto.long_meaning: امرنہ د ښځينو یو نوم دی چی د عربي ريښی 'أمَرَ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی معنی یې ده وده او پرمختګ. دا ريښه په قرآن کریم کی په ډیرو ځايونو کی ذکر شوی ده، لکه: 'وَأَمْرُنا لِلْمَرْءِ مَاضٍ' (الأحزاب: 5). دا نوم د ځواک، صبر او روحاني او احساساتی ودې نښه ده

in_english.name: Imrana
in_english.meaning: Imrana means strength, growth, and development
in_english.long_meaning: Imrana is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'أمَرَ' (amara), meaning to grow or to develop. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in verse 5 of Surah Al-Ahzab: 'وَأَمْرُنا لِلْمَرْءِ مَاضٍ'. The name Imrana symbolizes strength, patience, and spiritual and emotional growth. It reflects the values of resilience and inner development in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Imrana carries a rich cultural heritage in the Islamic world. It is not a commonly used name, but it does hold a significant place in the literature of the Islamic tradition. Imrana is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon), as the name of the maiden who was found in the South and gifted by the Queen of Sheba to the Prophet after he helped her solve a problem (27:34). This name reminds us of the Prophets' noble character, their power in helping people, and their deep connections with various communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Imrana lies in its origin from the Arabic root 'amr' meaning 'command' and 'relation'. The name imparts the essence of faithfulness and being a bond, not just with Allah, but also with family, community, and the world. With 'amr' being the root, the element of obedience and adherence to commands from Allah also becomes essential for the bearer of this name. As Imrana is a strong reminder of faithfulness and connection, those who carry it strive to reflect these virtues in their actions and relationships.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Imrana bint Harith (d. 652 CE) was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Imrana carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Imrana was a noblewoman from the Banu Jumah tribe who embraced Islam and became a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad. She is mentioned in several hadiths and is considered a role model for Muslim women.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Imrana remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Imrana from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia embodies the meaning of Imrana - "Faithful". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
